# MakerWorld PMM OpenSCAD Boilerplate

> A GitHub template and reference library for parametric OpenSCAD models published through
> MakerWorld's Parametric Model Maker (PMM). It contains a multi-file source layout, a build that
> flattens it into the single .scad PMM accepts, a PMM compatibility lint, render and Bambu 3MF
> pipelines, agent directives, and a snapshot of PMM's installed-library and font inventories.

Agents: start with AGENTS.md (rules and commands), then docs/INDEX.md (doc map and read order).

## Rules and entry points
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): canonical agent instructions, standing directives, folder layout, commands
- [docs/INDEX.md](docs/INDEX.md): every doc, what it answers, when to read it
- [docs/START-HERE.md](docs/START-HERE.md): what the boilerplate is and how to start a project

## PMM reference
- [docs/pmm/specification.md](docs/pmm/specification.md): PMM API surface (mw_plate_N, mw_assembly_view, customizer syntax, colors, fonts, uploads, backend)
- [docs/pmm/compatibility-rules.md](docs/pmm/compatibility-rules.md): rules with IDs matching the lint (P01-P12), limits, gotchas
- [docs/pmm/sources.md](docs/pmm/sources.md): where every claim comes from, with evidence levels and endpoint URLs
- [docs/pmm/data/](docs/pmm/data/): installed fonts, display font catalog, and bundled libraries (JSON snapshots)

## OpenSCAD and conventions
- [docs/openscad/customizer-syntax.md](docs/openscad/customizer-syntax.md): parameter annotation syntax
- [docs/openscad/libraries-and-fonts.md](docs/openscad/libraries-and-fonts.md): BOSL2, name collisions, fonts
- [docs/openscad/text-on-curved-surfaces.md](docs/openscad/text-on-curved-surfaces.md): text wrapped around round parts
- [docs/conventions/geometry.md](docs/conventions/geometry.md): origin, clearances, manifold safety
- [docs/conventions/source-architecture.md](docs/conventions/source-architecture.md): include vs use, params, bundle order
- [docs/conventions/naming.md](docs/conventions/naming.md): files, modules, parameters

## Toolchain and workflows
- [docs/toolchain/pipelines.md](docs/toolchain/pipelines.md): the build, dev, render, 3MF and check pipelines
- [docs/toolchain/setup.md](docs/toolchain/setup.md): installing OpenSCAD, Python, Git Bash, Bambu Studio, BOSL2, fonts
- [docs/workflows/](docs/workflows/): new project, add a part, add a parameter, multicolor, release, publish

## Optional
- [examples/demo/](examples/demo/): a runnable two-part example project (sliding-lid box)
